_note: 15 careers across the 8 families; 7 are 'full' depth, 8 are lighter 'card' careers. Written by the build team's assistant on 2026-11-19 from public sources found by web search; NOT yet reviewed by a human or by a domain expert. Every source has verified_on = null until a person opens it and sets the date. first_income_step is a practical suggestion, not a promise of income, and no rupee figures appear anywhere. Hindi and Marathi name/summary/first-income text are DRAFTS for native-speaker review; ladder text in Hindi and Marathi is machine-translated into careers_i18n.json. required_skills use ids from skills.json. startup_cost: none | low | medium (tools or stock the learner must buy). first_income_days is the team's estimate of how soon a first small income is realistic, used only for ranking. safety.under18_theory_only means a learner under 18 follows the learning steps and practises on a training board only, with no live electrical or hazardous work (CLAUDE.md section 11).

summary.en: Stitch and alter clothes for people nearby, then grow into a small tailoring business of your own.
summary.hi: आसपास के लोगों के कपड़े सिलिए और ठीक कीजिए, फिर उसे अपना छोटा सिलाई का काम बनाइए।
summary.mr: आजूबाजूच्या लोकांचे कपडे शिवा आणि दुरुस्त करा, मग त्याचा स्वतःचा छोटा शिवणकामाचा व्यवसाय करा.

first_income_step.en: Do alteration jobs for three neighbours, then stitch and sell your first few items locally.
first_income_step.hi: तीन पड़ोसियों के कपड़ों की अल्टरेशन कीजिए, फिर अपने पहले कुछ कपड़े सिलकर आसपास बेचिए।
first_income_step.mr: तीन शेजाऱ्यांचे कपडे दुरुस्त करा, मग तुमचे पहिले काही कपडे शिवून आजूबाजूला विका.

ladder.title: Watch and measure
ladder.detail: This week, watch a local tailor work for an hour and practise taking five body measurements on a family member.

ladder.title: Learn the basics
ladder.detail: Learn hand stitches, machine stitching, seams and basic cutting from a short course, a video series or a mentor.

ladder.title: Practise on real clothes
ladder.detail: Stitch a simple blouse or kurta and do alterations for family, with your mentor reviewing photos of your work.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Work towards a recognised Tailor qualification, a training place under a government scheme for craftspeople if you are eligible, or an apprenticeship with a master tailor.

ladder.title: Take orders
ladder.detail: Take stitching and alteration orders from neighbours and local shops, and grow into a small tailoring unit.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Tailor (Darzi) qualification file
sources.note: A recognised Tailor (Darzi) qualification exists. Records for tailor qualifications show different levels, so check the register for the current one.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Tailor (Darzi) Advance
sources.note: The next step up from the basic Tailor (Darzi) qualification.

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma official portal
sources.note: Government scheme for traditional craftspeople. Tailoring is reported to be one of its trades. Eligibility and benefits must be read on the portal.

summary.en: Make decorated fabric by hand, for clothes, bridal wear and home use.
summary.hi: कपड़ों, दुल्हन के परिधान और घर के सामान के लिए हाथ से सजावटी कढ़ाई कीजिए।
summary.mr: कपडे, वधूचे पोशाख आणि घरगुती वस्तूंसाठी हाताने सजावटी भरतकाम करा.

first_income_step.en: Embroider a set of handkerchiefs or a blouse border and sell them to people you know.
first_income_step.hi: रुमालों का एक सेट या ब्लाउज़ की बॉर्डर पर कढ़ाई करके जान-पहचान के लोगों को बेचिए।
first_income_step.mr: रुमालांचा एक संच किंवा ब्लाउजच्या काठावर भरतकाम करून ओळखीच्या लोकांना विका.

ladder.title: Look and try
ladder.detail: Look at embroidery on clothes around you and try five basic stitches on a scrap of cloth.

ladder.title: Learn stitches and patterns
ladder.detail: Learn common hand embroidery stitches and how to transfer a pattern to cloth.

ladder.title: Finish small pieces
ladder.detail: Complete small pieces such as handkerchiefs or borders and send photos to your mentor.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Traditional Hand Embroiderer qualification, or train with an experienced embroiderer.

ladder.title: Sell your work
ladder.detail: Sell pieces locally, take orders from tailors and boutiques, and grow from there.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Traditional Hand Embroiderer
sources.note: A recognised hand embroidery qualification from the Handicrafts Sector Skill Council; its electives are reported to include zari-zardozi work.

summary.en: Look after milk animals or poultry well and sell milk, eggs or birds, starting small and growing steadily.
summary.hi: दुधारू पशुओं या मुर्गियों की अच्छी देखभाल कीजिए और दूध, अंडे या मुर्गियाँ बेचिए, छोटे से शुरू करके धीरे-धीरे बढ़िए।
summary.mr: दुधाळ जनावरे किंवा कोंबड्यांची चांगली काळजी घ्या आणि दूध, अंडी किंवा कोंबड्या विका; लहान सुरुवात करून हळूहळू वाढवा.

first_income_step.en: Sell milk or eggs from animals or birds you already look after to neighbours or a local collection point.
first_income_step.hi: जिन पशुओं या मुर्गियों की आप पहले से देखभाल करते हैं, उनका दूध या अंडे पड़ोसियों या पास के संग्रह केंद्र पर बेचिए।
first_income_step.mr: तुम्ही आधीपासून सांभाळत असलेल्या जनावरांचे किंवा कोंबड्यांचे दूध किंवा अंडी शेजाऱ्यांना किंवा जवळच्या संकलन केंद्रावर विका.

ladder.title: Visit and observe
ladder.detail: Visit a well-run dairy or poultry farm nearby and note how animals are fed, housed and kept clean.

ladder.title: Learn animal care
ladder.detail: Learn feeding, clean housing, common illnesses to watch for, and basic record keeping, from your mentor or a local training centre.

ladder.title: Care for a small number
ladder.detail: Look after a small number of animals or birds with records of feed, yield and health that your mentor reviews.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Dairy Farmer Entrepreneur qualification and the poultry qualifications, or training from your nearest agricultural training centre.

ladder.title: Sell and grow
ladder.detail: Sell milk or eggs regularly, keep simple accounts, and expand only as your records show it pays.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Dairy Farmer - Entrepreneur
sources.note: A recognised dairy qualification from the Agriculture Skill Council of India, with Dairy Farm Supervisor as a next step.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Poultry Farm Supervisor
sources.note: A recognised poultry qualification; the Agriculture Skill Council also lists smaller-scale poultry packs.

summary.en: Grow mushrooms or keep bees in a small space, with little land needed.
summary.hi: थोड़ी सी जगह में मशरूम उगाइए या मधुमक्खियाँ पालिए, ज़्यादा ज़मीन की ज़रूरत नहीं।
summary.mr: थोड्या जागेत मशरूम पिकवा किंवा मधमाश्या पाळा; जास्त जमिनीची गरज नाही.

first_income_step.en: Grow your first batch of mushrooms, or collect your first honey, and sell it locally.
first_income_step.hi: मशरूम की अपनी पहली फ़सल उगाइए, या पहला शहद निकालिए, और उसे आसपास बेचिए।
first_income_step.mr: मशरूमचं तुमचं पहिलं पीक घ्या किंवा पहिला मध काढा आणि तो आजूबाजूला विका.

ladder.title: See it done
ladder.detail: Visit someone who grows mushrooms or keeps bees and ask how a week looks.

ladder.title: Get trained
ladder.detail: Do a short training on the one you choose, from an agricultural training centre or a government-supported programme.

ladder.title: Start very small
ladder.detail: Begin with a few mushroom bags or a couple of hives, and send photos and notes to your mentor.

ladder.title: Look for support
ladder.detail: Ask your nearest agricultural training centre about training and any support available for beekeepers.

ladder.title: Sell the produce
ladder.detail: Sell fresh mushrooms or honey locally and grow only as demand shows.

sources.title: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission: operational guidelines
sources.note: Official guidelines of the government mission that supports beekeeping. Its current phase must be checked.

sources.title: National Horticulture Board: mushroom training brochure (ICAR Directorate of Mushroom Research)
sources.note: Older (2019-20) brochure; says the directorate trains growers and rural youth in mushroom cultivation. Current dates and fees must be confirmed.

summary.en: Learn to install and repair wiring, switches and fittings in homes, safely and under supervision.
summary.hi: घरों में वायरिंग, स्विच और फिटिंग लगाना और ठीक करना सीखिए, सुरक्षित तरीके से और देखरेख में।
summary.mr: घरांमध्ये वायरिंग, स्विच आणि फिटिंग बसवणे आणि दुरुस्त करणे शिका, सुरक्षितपणे आणि देखरेखीखाली.

first_income_step.en: Help a licensed electrician on supervised jobs. Live electrical work is for adults only.
first_income_step.hi: लाइसेंस वाले इलेक्ट्रीशियन की देखरेख में उनके काम में मदद कीजिए। चालू बिजली पर काम सिर्फ़ वयस्कों के लिए है।
first_income_step.mr: परवानाधारक इलेक्ट्रिशियनच्या देखरेखीखाली त्यांच्या कामात मदत करा. चालू विजेवरचं काम फक्त प्रौढांसाठी आहे.

safety.disclaimer: KHOJ does not make anyone a licensed electrician. Only the licensing authority can do that, and an AI or a mentor approving your photos never means a job is safe.

ladder.title: Learn the parts and the dangers
ladder.detail: Learn the parts of a home circuit (switch, MCB, earth) and why electricity is dangerous. Do not touch live wiring.

ladder.title: Learn safe working
ladder.detail: Learn tools, wire types, colour codes, isolating and tagging a circuit before any work, and testing with a meter.

ladder.title: Practise on a training board
ladder.detail: Wire a switch and light on a dead training board, with photos that your mentor reviews. Live circuits are never practised from photos.

ladder.title: Get the right paper
ladder.detail: Look at the Maharashtra wireman permit route and a government trade course. Working legally on wiring needs the official permit, and your mentor or a qualified assessor must watch your first live work.

ladder.title: Work under a licensed electrician
ladder.detail: Start as a helper to a licensed electrician or contractor, and grow towards your own permitted work.

sources.title: Maharashtra Chief Electrical Inspector: licensing and wireman permit
sources.note: The authority that licenses electrical workers and contractors in Maharashtra. Eligibility, exam dates and fees must be read here.

sources.title: Directorate General of Training: Electrician trade
sources.note: A government trade course for electricians.

sources.title: MSME Technology Centre: Assistant Electrician (domestic cum industrial) qualification file
sources.note: An entry-level electrician qualification file.

summary.en: Install, service and repair the water pumps and electric motors that farms and homes depend on.
summary.hi: खेतों और घरों में काम आने वाले पानी के पंप और बिजली की मोटर लगाइए, सर्विस कीजिए और ठीक कीजिए।
summary.mr: शेतात आणि घरात लागणारे पाण्याचे पंप आणि विजेच्या मोटारी बसवा, सर्व्हिस करा आणि दुरुस्त करा.

first_income_step.en: Assist a local pump and motor mechanic on supervised service jobs. Live electrical work is for adults only.
first_income_step.hi: पास के पंप और मोटर मैकेनिक की देखरेख में सर्विस के कामों में मदद कीजिए। चालू बिजली पर काम सिर्फ़ वयस्कों के लिए है।
first_income_step.mr: जवळच्या पंप आणि मोटार मेकॅनिकच्या देखरेखीखाली सर्व्हिसच्या कामात मदत करा. चालू विजेवरचं काम फक्त प्रौढांसाठी आहे.

safety.disclaimer: KHOJ does not certify anyone to work on electrical equipment. Never run or test a motor on the strength of photos or an AI check.

ladder.title: See how they work
ladder.detail: Watch a mechanic open a pump or motor, and learn the main parts and the dangers of mains power and moving shafts.

ladder.title: Learn the parts and the checks
ladder.detail: Learn bearings, seals, windings, switches and starters, and how to isolate power before any work.

ladder.title: Practise on dead equipment
ladder.detail: Take apart and rebuild an old pump or motor that is disconnected, with photos reviewed by your mentor. Test runs are always supervised in person.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Irrigation Service Technician, Water Pump Operator and Pump Operator cum Mechanic courses, and ask your training centre which fits.

ladder.title: Work as a helper, then on your own
ladder.detail: Start as a helper with a mechanic, then take small service jobs as you gain experience.

learn_links.title: Find pump and motor repair courses

sources.title: Agriculture Skill Council of India: Irrigation Service Technician (small capacity) qualification pack
sources.note: Covers installing and repairing submersible pumps and rewinding electric motors.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Water Pump Operator
sources.note: Lists Motor Mechanic as a progression step.

sources.title: Directorate General of Training: Pump Operator cum Mechanic
sources.note: A government trade course.

summary.en: Fix screens, batteries, charging ports and software problems on phones.
summary.hi: फ़ोन की स्क्रीन, बैटरी, चार्जिंग पोर्ट और सॉफ़्टवेयर की समस्याएँ ठीक कीजिए।
summary.mr: फोनची स्क्रीन, बॅटरी, चार्जिंग पोर्ट आणि सॉफ्टवेअरच्या समस्या दुरुस्त करा.

first_income_step.en: Help at a local phone repair shop, then fix simple problems such as screen protectors, software resets and battery swaps.
first_income_step.hi: पास की मोबाइल मरम्मत की दुकान में मदद कीजिए, फिर स्क्रीन गार्ड, सॉफ़्टवेयर रीसेट और बैटरी बदलने जैसे आसान काम कीजिए।
first_income_step.mr: जवळच्या मोबाईल दुरुस्तीच्या दुकानात मदत करा, मग स्क्रीन गार्ड, सॉफ्टवेअर रीसेट आणि बॅटरी बदलणे अशी सोपी कामे करा.

safety.note: Phone batteries can swell and catch fire if damaged, so learn battery safety first.

ladder.title: Watch and ask
ladder.detail: Spend an hour watching a repair shop and note the five most common problems.

ladder.title: Learn the parts
ladder.detail: Learn the parts of a phone, safe opening, the tools, and basic testing with a multimeter.

ladder.title: Practise on old phones
ladder.detail: Open and rebuild old phones you are allowed to practise on, with photos of each stage reviewed by your mentor.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Handheld Devices (Handset and Tablet) Technician qualification from the Telecom Sector Skill Council.

ladder.title: Work in a shop or start small
ladder.detail: Work in a repair shop, then take small repair jobs of your own as your skill and tools grow.

sources.title: Telecom Sector Skill Council: Handheld Devices (Handset and Tablet) Technician qualification pack
sources.note: The recognised qualification pack for phone repair; earlier versions were called Handset Repair Engineer.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Handheld Devices (Mobile and Accessories) Technician
sources.note: A related recognised qualification.

summary.en: Help install and maintain solar panels and solar pumps, working with a trained team.
summary.hi: प्रशिक्षित टीम के साथ सोलर पैनल और सोलर पंप लगाने और उनकी देखभाल में मदद कीजिए।
summary.mr: प्रशिक्षित टीमसोबत सोलर पॅनल आणि सोलर पंप बसवण्यात आणि त्यांच्या देखभालीत मदत करा.

first_income_step.en: Join a local solar installer as a helper on ground-level tasks. Work at height and on live wiring is for trained adults only.
first_income_step.hi: स्थानीय सोलर इंस्टॉलर के साथ ज़मीन पर होने वाले कामों में सहायक बनिए। ऊँचाई पर और चालू तारों पर काम सिर्फ़ प्रशिक्षित वयस्कों के लिए है।
first_income_step.mr: स्थानिक सोलर इन्स्टॉलरसोबत जमिनीवरच्या कामात सहाय्यक व्हा. उंचीवरचं आणि चालू तारांवरचं काम फक्त प्रशिक्षित प्रौढांसाठी आहे.

safety.disclaimer: KHOJ does not certify anyone to install solar equipment or work at height.

ladder.title: Learn how solar works
ladder.detail: Learn how a panel, inverter and battery work together and the dangers of direct current and heights.

ladder.title: Take a basics course
ladder.detail: Take a short course on solar installation basics, safe handling, and reading simple diagrams.

ladder.title: Practise on a training kit
ladder.detail: Practise connecting a small training kit, with photos reviewed by your mentor. No rooftop work from photos.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra) qualification and the national solar skill programme.

ladder.title: Join an installer
ladder.detail: Join a local installer as a helper and grow into maintenance and installation work.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra)
sources.note: The recognised installer qualification under the national Suryamitra programme.

sources.title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy: solar human resource development
sources.note: Where the ministry lists its solar skilling programmes. Eligibility must be read at the training centre.

name.hi: घर का कैटरिंग और टिफ़िन सेवा

summary.en: Cook meals at home for workers, students and small events, with clean and safe food.
summary.hi: कामगारों, विद्यार्थियों और छोटे कार्यक्रमों के लिए घर पर साफ़ और सुरक्षित खाना बनाइए।
summary.mr: कामगार, विद्यार्थी आणि छोट्या कार्यक्रमांसाठी घरी स्वच्छ आणि सुरक्षित जेवण बनवा.

first_income_step.en: Cook tiffins for two or three regular customers, or take your first small event order.
first_income_step.hi: दो-तीन नियमित ग्राहकों के लिए टिफ़िन बनाइए, या किसी छोटे कार्यक्रम का पहला ऑर्डर लीजिए।
first_income_step.mr: दोन-तीन नियमित ग्राहकांसाठी डबे बनवा किंवा एखाद्या छोट्या कार्यक्रमाची पहिली ऑर्डर घ्या.

safety.note: Selling food usually needs food-safety registration. Check the rules before you start.

ladder.title: Find your first customers
ladder.detail: Ask three people nearby what meals they would pay for, and what they pay for them today.

ladder.title: Learn food safety and costing
ladder.detail: Learn clean cooking, storage, portion sizes and how to work out what each meal costs you.

ladder.title: Cook a trial batch
ladder.detail: Cook a trial batch for friends and ask for honest feedback on taste, quantity and timing.

ladder.title: Register properly
ladder.detail: Find out which food-safety registration you need before you sell, and look for a food or hospitality training course.

ladder.title: Serve regular customers
ladder.detail: Serve regular tiffin customers or take event orders, and track what each order earns.

sources.title: FSSAI: Food Licensing and Registration System (FoSCoS)
sources.note: The official portal for food business registration and licences. Which kind you need depends on how you sell, so read the current rules there.

name.hi: दुकान का हिसाब और जीएसटी सहायक

summary.en: Keep books, bills and tax records for small shops and help them stay in order.
summary.hi: छोटी दुकानों के खाते, बिल और टैक्स के रिकॉर्ड रखिए और उन्हें व्यवस्थित रखने में मदद कीजिए।
summary.mr: लहान दुकानांचे खाते, बिले आणि कराच्या नोंदी ठेवा आणि त्यांना व्यवस्थित ठेवण्यास मदत करा.

first_income_step.en: Keep the daily books for two or three local shops.
first_income_step.hi: दो-तीन स्थानीय दुकानों के रोज़ के खाते लिखिए।
first_income_step.mr: दोन-तीन स्थानिक दुकानांचे रोजचे खाते लिहा.

safety.note: Acting as a registered GST practitioner has its own eligibility rules; helping a shop keep its books does not.

ladder.title: Read a shop's books
ladder.detail: Ask a shopkeeper to show you how they record daily sales, purchases and dues, and copy one page.

ladder.title: Learn bookkeeping and billing
ladder.detail: Learn a simple cash book and ledger, how a GST bill is made, and basic accounting on a computer or phone.

ladder.title: Keep a practice set of books
ladder.detail: Keep a full set of practice books for a sample shop for one month, with your mentor reviewing it.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at recognised courses on Tally and GST, and later the Corporate Accountant qualification as a next step.

ladder.title: Keep books for shops
ladder.detail: Keep books and file simple records for several shops, and grow towards a small accounts service.

learn_links.title: Find accounting, Tally and GST courses

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Corporate Accountant
sources.note: A higher-level recognised accounting qualification covering bookkeeping, GST and TDS.

sources.title: GST portal
sources.note: Where businesses register and file. Enrolling as a GST practitioner has its own eligibility rules, so read them here.

summary.en: Run a village centre that helps people with government forms, bill payments and other digital services.
summary.hi: गाँव का ऐसा केंद्र चलाइए जो लोगों को सरकारी फ़ॉर्म, बिल भुगतान और दूसरी डिजिटल सेवाओं में मदद करे।
summary.mr: गावातलं असं केंद्र चालवा जे लोकांना सरकारी अर्ज, बिल भरणे आणि इतर डिजिटल सेवांमध्ये मदत करतं.

first_income_step.en: Help at an existing centre or a local shop with online forms and printouts, and earn a small fee per service.
first_income_step.hi: किसी मौजूदा केंद्र या स्थानीय दुकान पर ऑनलाइन फ़ॉर्म और प्रिंटआउट में मदद कीजिए, और हर सेवा पर थोड़ी फ़ीस कमाइए।
first_income_step.mr: सध्याच्या केंद्रावर किंवा स्थानिक दुकानात ऑनलाइन अर्ज आणि प्रिंटआउटमध्ये मदत करा आणि प्रत्येक सेवेवर थोडी फी मिळवा.

ladder.title: See what the centre does
ladder.detail: Visit a nearby Common Service Centre and list the services people ask for.

ladder.title: Learn the basics
ladder.detail: Learn computer and internet basics, how to fill common online forms, and how to explain them clearly to others.

ladder.title: Help people with forms
ladder.detail: Help family and neighbours fill genuine forms with their consent, with your mentor checking your process.

ladder.title: Check the requirements
ladder.detail: Read the official requirements for becoming a village-level entrepreneur, including the age and school requirement.

ladder.title: Run a centre
ladder.detail: Start or join a centre and earn a fee per service.

sources.title: Common Service Centres: frequently asked questions
sources.note: The official page says a village-level entrepreneur must be at least 18 and have passed Class 10. Read it before applying.

name.hi: बच्चों की देखभाल और घर पर ट्यूशन

summary.en: Look after young children or help them learn, as a crèche helper or a home tutor.
summary.hi: क्रेच सहायक या घर के ट्यूटर के रूप में छोटे बच्चों की देखभाल कीजिए या उन्हें पढ़ने में मदद कीजिए।
summary.mr: पाळणाघर सहाय्यक किंवा घरगुती शिक्षक म्हणून लहान मुलांची काळजी घ्या किंवा त्यांना शिकण्यास मदत करा.

first_income_step.en: Tutor two or three younger children in your neighbourhood, or help at a local crèche.
first_income_step.hi: अपने मोहल्ले के दो-तीन छोटे बच्चों को पढ़ाइए, या पास के क्रेच में मदद कीजिए।
first_income_step.mr: तुमच्या वस्तीतल्या दोन-तीन लहान मुलांना शिकवा किंवा जवळच्या पाळणाघरात मदत करा.

safety.note: Always work with a parent's or guardian's knowledge, and never alone with a child behind closed doors.

ladder.title: Spend time with children
ladder.detail: Spend an afternoon helping with younger children and notice what keeps them interested.

ladder.title: Learn child-friendly teaching
ladder.detail: Learn simple teaching methods, child safety and hygiene, and how to plan a short lesson or play activity.

ladder.title: Teach a small group
ladder.detail: Teach one or two children for a few weeks and keep notes on their progress that your mentor reviews.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Early Childhood Educator trade course and related child-care qualifications.

ladder.title: Tutor or work at a crèche
ladder.detail: Give paid tuition or work at a crèche or pre-school as an assistant.

sources.title: Directorate General of Training: Early Childhood Educator trade
sources.note: A government trade course for early childhood educators.

name.hi: स्थानीय दुकानों के लिए डिजिटल मार्केटिंग

summary.en: Help local shops get customers with photos, posts and messages on phones and social media.
summary.hi: फ़ोटो, पोस्ट और संदेशों से स्थानीय दुकानों को फ़ोन और सोशल मीडिया पर ग्राहक दिलाने में मदद कीजिए।
summary.mr: फोटो, पोस्ट आणि संदेशांद्वारे स्थानिक दुकानांना फोन आणि सोशल मीडियावर ग्राहक मिळवून देण्यास मदत करा.

first_income_step.en: Make a simple shop profile with good photos and posts for one local shop, and be paid a small fee.
first_income_step.hi: एक स्थानीय दुकान के लिए अच्छी फ़ोटो और पोस्ट के साथ एक सरल प्रोफ़ाइल बनाइए, और थोड़ी फ़ीस लीजिए।
first_income_step.mr: एका स्थानिक दुकानासाठी चांगले फोटो आणि पोस्टसह साधी प्रोफाइल बनवा आणि थोडी फी घ्या.

safety.note: Never post a customer's or a child's photo without their permission, and never share anyone's phone number or address.

ladder.title: Look at what shops post
ladder.detail: Look at how three local shops show themselves online, and write down one thing each could do better.

ladder.title: Learn the tools
ladder.detail: Learn to take clear product photos on a phone, write short posts in your language, and use a shop profile on maps and messaging apps.

ladder.title: Build a sample for one shop
ladder.detail: Make a sample set of photos and posts for one shop, with your mentor reviewing them.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Search Engine Marketing Executive and Social Media Manager qualifications as later steps.

ladder.title: Look after shops' pages
ladder.detail: Look after the online pages of several shops for a monthly fee.

sources.title: Media and Entertainment Skills Council: Search Engine Marketing Executive (MES/Q0705)
sources.note: A recognised qualification pack in online marketing.

sources.title: Media and Entertainment Skills Council: Social Media Manager (MES/Q0703)
sources.note: A recognised qualification pack in social media work.

summary.en: Take and edit photos and short videos for events, shops and families.
summary.hi: कार्यक्रमों, दुकानों और परिवारों के लिए फ़ोटो और छोटे वीडियो लीजिए और एडिट कीजिए।
summary.mr: कार्यक्रम, दुकाने आणि कुटुंबांसाठी फोटो आणि छोटे व्हिडिओ काढा आणि एडिट करा.

first_income_step.en: Take photos at a small family event or for a local shop and be paid for your first shoot.
first_income_step.hi: किसी छोटे पारिवारिक कार्यक्रम या स्थानीय दुकान के लिए फ़ोटो खींचिए और पहली शूटिंग के पैसे लीजिए।
first_income_step.mr: एखाद्या छोट्या कौटुंबिक कार्यक्रमात किंवा स्थानिक दुकानासाठी फोटो काढा आणि पहिल्या शूटचे पैसे मिळवा.

safety.note: Always ask permission before photographing people, and be careful with children's photos.

ladder.title: Study good photos
ladder.detail: Look at photos you admire and try to take five in the same style with your phone.

ladder.title: Learn light and framing
ladder.detail: Learn light, framing, steady shots and simple editing on a phone or computer.

ladder.title: Shoot a small project
ladder.detail: Shoot and edit a short project such as a festival or a shop, and share it with your mentor.

ladder.title: Get recognised
ladder.detail: Look at the Still Photographer qualification, with videography as a later step.

ladder.title: Take paid shoots
ladder.detail: Take paid shoots at events and for shops, and build a small portfolio.

sources.title: National Qualifications Register: Still Photographer
sources.note: A recognised photography qualification; its listed progression includes videographer.

summary.en: Prepare for state and national recruitment exams, and help younger students prepare too.
summary.hi: राज्य और राष्ट्रीय भर्ती परीक्षाओं की तैयारी कीजिए और छोटे विद्यार्थियों को भी तैयारी में मदद कीजिए।
summary.mr: राज्य आणि राष्ट्रीय भरती परीक्षांची तयारी करा आणि लहान विद्यार्थ्यांनाही तयारीत मदत करा.

first_income_step.en: Tutor younger students in the subjects you are strong in, while you prepare for your own exam.
first_income_step.hi: अपनी परीक्षा की तैयारी करते हुए, जिन विषयों में आप मज़बूत हैं उनमें छोटे विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाइए।
first_income_step.mr: तुमच्या स्वतःच्या परीक्षेची तयारी करत असताना, ज्या विषयांत तुम्ही मजबूत आहात त्यात लहान विद्यार्थ्यांना शिकवा.

ladder.title: Pick your exams
ladder.detail: Find out which recruitment exams you could take and what each one asks for, including age and education.

ladder.title: Study with a plan
ladder.detail: Make a weekly study plan, use free study resources, and learn the exam pattern.

ladder.title: Take practice tests
ladder.detail: Take timed practice tests every week and review mistakes with your mentor.

ladder.title: Apply for the exam
ladder.detail: Apply when you meet the age and education conditions in the official notice.

ladder.title: Tutor while you prepare
ladder.detail: Earn by tutoring younger students while you prepare, and move into a government post if you succeed.

sources.title: Maharashtra Public Service Commission
sources.note: The official site for state recruitment exams and notices. Age and education conditions are in each notice.
